name: 2-ethylhexylamine
description: 2-Ethylhexylamine (CAS 104-75-6 ) is a branched-chain primary amine used as a chemical intermediate and functional additive across several industrial sectors. Its long, branched carbon chain makes it effective where oil-soluble amine character is needed. This chemical is essential for corrosion protection, pH control, and emulsification in non-aqueous systems. In oilfield and refinery operations, it functions as a corrosion inhibitor and neutralizing amine in pipeline treatment and process fluid formulations. Lubricant and metalworking fluid manufacturers use it to build amine-based additives that protect metal surfaces. These additives stabilize emulsions under demanding conditions, ensuring long-term performance in industrial machinery and automotive applications. In coatings and adhesive systems, it acts as a curing agent component or pH modifier. This improves resin compatibility and film performance, making it a versatile choice for high-performance industrial coatings and specialized adhesive products. Water treatment formulators incorporate it into corrosion inhibitor packages for industrial cooling and boiler systems. It is often selected where oil-soluble amines are preferred over water-soluble alternatives to ensure system integrity. The product is supplied as a clear liquid in drums, IBCs, and bulk isotanks for global distribution. It is available primarily in technical grade, with purity levels typically at 99% or higher depending on the specific supplier specification. Buyers should confirm amine content and water specification when sourcing for sensitive formulation or synthesis applications.
